title: Choo-choo train, the same words, the wheel rule in the tool (a negative result)
model: Purple Skippy: Claude Code on Skippy Core's coder (the same Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, MTP, Q8), local and free, the same message as v5 word for word; the voxel skill now carries the forward-axis rule
verdict: A negative result, kept. The wheels are still turned: the runtime's wheel check finds eight black discs whose faces point along the track, the same mistake as v6, although the one rule was in the skill and in the agent's header. The one fix it made was to the boiler loops (commit 0a910d4), which stopped blocks floating past the shell. 31 floating parts remain (44 blocks, small iron pieces at the driving wheels). It is three times v5's blocks, and the rule the Captain asked for is not yet enforced by the builder, only written down.
